map.由就业与失业人数求劳动力: Finding the labor force from the numbers employed and unemployed
map.输入就业人数 E 与失业人数 U，求劳动力规模。: Enter the number employed E and the number unemployed U to get the size of the labor force.
map.📖 查看「由就业与失业人数求劳动力 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Finding the Labor Force from the Numbers Employed and Unemployed Usage Guide"
map.📚 深度解析：由就业与失业人数求劳动力: 📚 Deep Dive: Finding the Labor Force from the Numbers Employed and Unemployed
map.劳动力核算：录入就业与失业，算劳动力总量。: Labor force accounting: enter employment and unemployment to get the total labor force.
map.结构拆分：看就业/失业占比。: Structural split: look at the employed / unemployed shares.
map.教学演示：演示不在劳动力者不计入分母。: Teaching demo: show that people outside the labor force are not counted in the denominator.
map.示例：就业 6600 万、失业 400 万，劳动力=7000 万。: Example: 66 million employed and 4 million unemployed give a labor force of 70 million.
map.无工作但在近期积极寻找且可立即工作者，被动退出者不算失业也不算劳动力。结果仅作经: People without a job who have actively searched recently and can start immediately; those who withdraw passively count neither as unemployed nor as part of the labor force. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
map.和总人口？: How does it relate to the total population?
map.劳动力≤适龄人口，差额为不参与率（学生/退休/照护等）。结果仅作经济学教学与快速: The labor force is no larger than the working-age population; the gap is the non-participation (students, retirees, caregivers and so on). Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
map.非正规或低意愿就业难完全统计，官方口径以调查失业为准。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测: Informal or low-commitment work is hard to capture fully; official figures rely on the surveyed unemployed. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
